description: EIAdata is an R wrapper for the United States Energy Information Administration API. Its README says it was updated for API version 2 and describes finding a legacy series identifier before requesting one of the agency's many time series. Users provide a free EIA API key and select an energy series; outputs are reported values for that series. Geographic coverage follows the chosen EIA product, commonly United States national or regional energy systems. The package DESCRIPTION states GPL-2 licensing, while the agency's published data have separate terms. A limitation is that the README's series-discovery instructions rely on version 1 identifiers and older website paths; a user must verify current endpoint mapping and revisions. EIAdata can prepare generation, demand or fuel-price inputs for energy simulations. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model needs scenario data but is not an EIA client. No key, records or R package were downloaded.
